findings.title: Phrase drawing setup failures bypass owned passphrase cleanup
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Bounded local API/tooling defect; no exploitable disclosure, wrong cryptographic output or mandatory release gate failure demonstrated.
findings.expected: All package-owned passphrase copies are wiped on refused preparation; partial workers/slot ownership are cleaned on failure.
findings.observed: Positive safe integer 2**32 is accepted. Two passphrase copies are encoded, then new Array(count) immediately throws RangeError before normal-path fill(0).
findings.impact: Local owned-buffer residual lifetime on host-invalid options. No enormous allocation, worker creation, network disclosure, memory persistence beyond GC or theft demonstrated.
findings.reproduction: Call unchanged MhfeWallet.drawPhrase with synthetic matching passphrase, walletCheck:true and workers:2**32. Probe observes exactly two copies and asserts wipe after rejection.
findings.evidence: browser/draw-refusal.mjs exits 1; independently reproduced by browser reviewer and challenged by CLI/docs skeptic.
findings.recommendedFix: Bound worker-count inputs before encoding and protect all drawing setup allocations/copies/start calls with finally cleanup. On partial setup failure stop started workers and release the operation slot.
findings.requiredVerification: Invalid count, array allocation, first/second per-worker copy and worker-start failures wipe all owned copies, preserve caller buffers, stop partial jobs and permit subsequent drawing.

findings.title: Recovered result exposes a relocatable secret buffer outside its lock owner
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Bounded local API/tooling defect; no exploitable disclosure, wrong cryptographic output or mandatory release gate failure demonstrated.
findings.expected: The library-owned recovered text cannot grow or relocate while a private guard protects its original allocation.
findings.observed: RecoveredPhrase::phrase is a public mutable Zeroizing<String>. Its constructor splits LockedText into that string and a private LockedPages guard whose start/bytes never follow String growth or replacement. Safe external reserve/push_str compiles.
findings.impact: Unenforced API secret-lifetime invariant and possible unlocked replacement storage when a native caller mutates a recovered result. Current CLI/browser callers were not shown doing this. No runtime swap/freed-memory disclosure measured; relocation/free concerns follow from ownership source, not a captured secret.
findings.reproduction: Compile rust/public-mutation.rs against freshly checked libmhfe.rlib. Its safe external function reserves extra capacity and appends synthetic text through the public field; inspect the immutable guard range and no RecoveredPhrase mutation precondition.
findings.evidence: public-mutation-current compiles exit 0; coordinator source trace plus independent Rust ownership challenge. Compile-only witness, not actual recovery/swap test.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep the owned phrase as private LockedText and expose a read-only phrase accessor. Update front ends/types/docs consistently; consider read-only factual metadata to retain result invariants.
findings.requiredVerification: External compile-fail regression prevents grow/replace mutation, normal read/consume paths still work, and native lock/zeroize tests confirm locked allocation lifetime.

findings.title: Clone checker drops active exported function code as if it were an import
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Bounded local API/tooling defect; no exploitable disclosure, wrong cryptographic output or mandatory release gate failure demonstrated.
findings.expected: Only actual import/re-export declarations are excluded; long identical active exported function bodies are compared.
findings.observed: Any export with a from identifier within 64 tokens is treated as a re-export; tokens are skipped through the first semicolon. Two exported functions with parameter from and a long identical arithmetic statement therefore pass default threshold.
findings.impact: False-negative coverage in the newly added lexical gate. No current production duplicate was established by this synthetic case, and semantic/short-fragment blindness is a separate acknowledged limitation.
findings.reproduction: Execute unchanged checker in a VM with virtual web/a.js and web/b.js. Ordinary 99-token duplicate fails control; identical exported functions sample(from) with >100-token body pass default 50-token gate.
findings.evidence: quality/clone-checker.mjs prints both controls and exits 1 on required detection assertion; independently challenged by package reviewer.
findings.recommendedFix: Recognize declaration syntax and distinguish export function/class from re-export forms; use an existing parser if proportionate, or narrowly tokenize declarations with tests.
findings.requiredVerification: Long exported functions/classes containing from must trigger clones; real import/re-export lists still excluded. Cover templates, dynamic import, multiline declarations and positive controls.

findings.title: Invalid clone-token thresholds silently produce a passing empty check
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Bounded local API/tooling defect; no exploitable disclosure, wrong cryptographic output or mandatory release gate failure demonstrated.
findings.expected: Malformed/nonfinite token threshold is rejected rather than reported as a clean source scan.
findings.observed: --tokens NaN is converted to NaN; all window-loop conditions are false, so zero windows are tested and process exits 0 with No copies of NaN tokens.
findings.impact: False-success for malformed manual/tool configuration. Normal check.sh uses default 50 and is not bypassed by this case.
findings.reproduction: Run virtual ordinary duplicate control with args --tokens NaN; the unchanged checker exits 0 though default control exits 1.
findings.evidence: quality/clone-checker.mjs retained result invalidThreshold.status=0 and No copies of NaN tokens; this is a distinct validation root cause.
findings.recommendedFix: Validate a finite positive safe-integer threshold and missing/duplicate option policy before scanning.
findings.requiredVerification: NaN, Infinity, zero, negatives, fractions, missing argument and oversized nonsafe integers refuse nonzero; legal thresholds detect controls.

limitations: No full-size Argon2 operational tests/vector replays, independent full-cost Python replays or ignored full-cost tests.
No canonical Docker/WASM rebuild, archive/signature/reproducibility acceptance, remote CI or Windows/macOS execution.
Existing browser artifacts are checked by manifests/stamps/source equality and dependency timestamps; those do not prove canonical reproducibility.
No exhaustive upstream dependency audit/current advisory search or independent cryptographic security certification.
External Deriver fields/workflows, cross-project handover and host accessibility are not tested end to end.
Mock lifecycle/draw probes isolate unchanged public preparation code; real browser run is separate evidence.
Rust public-mutation witness is compile-only. No consumer-induced runtime relocation, swap exposure, freed-memory capture or actual key disclosure was measured.
Clone probe uses virtual synthetic filesystem with unchanged production algorithm; its initial reviewer harness path error was corrected and is not a production failure.
Seven source/binding/docs/script files and browser artifacts changed concurrently. Baseline and later snapshots are retained; affected checks are rerun on the later snapshot, not merged silently.
Optimization recommendations are source-based hypotheses, not measured speedups. Cryptographic cost, zeroization and security gates must not be reduced.
Production code, dependencies, fixtures and workflows were not edited. No commit/push/tag/release authorized.
qualityAssessment: The refactor improves cohesion and reuse. Domain types retain focused responsibilities, frontend adapters reuse library rules, shared Feistel round application is reasonable, and a single shallow browser base composes one runtime. No further mandatory module split was established. A zero result from the 50-token clone heuristic is not proof of semantic DRY or absence of all copied code.

optimizations.proposal: Replace per-candidate Vec<Vec<u16>> inner allocations with fixed two-element records or flat storage when appropriate.
optimizations.reason: Two missing words in a 12-word container yield on the order of 262,144 checksum-valid candidates; each values.clone() allocates an inner vector.
optimizations.verification: Benchmark native and browser enumeration time, allocation count and peak RSS; preserve candidate ordering, count, match results and cancellation. No benchmark was executed.

optimizations.proposal: Reuse an internal validated/parsed original across facts, detection and encryption.
optimizations.reason: Several successive phrase parsing/normalization passes are visible; overhead is likely small relative to full Argon2.
optimizations.verification: Measure before introducing another owner; preserve locked/zeroizing storage and refusal order, do not retain extra secret copies.

optimizations.proposal: Consider rolling hashes plus exact collision comparison instead of a joined 50-token string for every window.
optimizations.reason: The current detector performs per-window slicing/joining and retains long string keys.
optimizations.verification: Only change after measuring checker time/RSS; retain positive/negative parser controls and exact-match verification.

optimizations.proposal: Let Reference own address-limit adjustment instead of reconstructing its variants in decoy_reference.
optimizations.reason: Reduces caller coupling; no current wrong result demonstrated.
optimizations.verification: Reference variant and search-limit regression tests.

principles: SRP
Library owns encryption, repair, password and wallet rules; front ends adapt. No further mandatory module split identified.
OCP
Variants/traits carry most changeable behavior; optional Reference limit-copy helper can reduce caller coupling.
LSP
Native/browser Argon2 and worker contracts checked by KATs and package parity; no proven contract violation.
ISP
Small engine/randomness/progress interfaces and four focused browser classes.
DIP
Host services injected via traits/callbacks; CLI is not the domain implementation.
DRY
Named CLI message copies from AUD-011 are gone. The new 50-token gate passes current files but has parser/argument defects (ARC001/ARC002) and cannot prove semantic DRY.
Encapsulation
Domain types generally keep private state; RecoveredPhrase exposes mutable locked text (SEC002), and draw preparation has an exceptional cleanup gap (SEC001).
Composition
ModuleWorker/PackageCheck/OperationSlot/WorkerJob and Rust service composition avoid deep inheritance.
Interfaces
Engine/progress/worker boundaries are narrow and testable.
Delegation
ContainerFacts/Suite/Reference/LengthDetection answer their own capabilities rather than callers re-deciding word counts.

verification.scopedResult: Partially fixed, narrowly incomplete. Invalid 2**32 worker count refuses before copying, and six setup/partial-start controls wipe owned arrays, stop partial jobs and allow slot reuse. One bounded injected failure remains: new Uint8Array(0) after the first encoded copy but before try at web/wallet.js:148 leaves one owned copy unwiped.
verification.remainingFix: Create the empty repetition before copying the first secret or place every later constructor under cleanup using an optional owner. Retain all six passing controls and the initial-empty-array failure regression.
verification.limitations: Synthetic constructor refusal only; no actual OOM, browser memory access or disclosure. Retains the original finding ID because all-setup cleanup is the same root.

verification.scopedResult: RecoveredPhrase fields are private; read accessors and into_phrase() move/read the lock-owning value. Positive read/consume witness compiles. Original safe public-mutation witness is refused with two E0616 diagnostics. Native memory ownership/locking tests pass.
verification.limitations: Compile witnesses prove API ownership boundaries, not runtime recovery, swap exposure, guaranteed erasure or mathematical secrecy. DOC001 separately records stale example adaptation.
